run_make_submission_file: run the script to create an evalAI submission file from OC20 or OC22 split results
run_make_submission_file_is2re_relaxatio: run the script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory directories
run_make_submission_file_hybrid: run the script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF NPZ files
run_make_submission_file_oc22: run the script with --dataset OC22 to create a submission file for the OC22 dataset
review_write_is2re_relaxations: review the write_is2re_relaxations function that extracts IDs and energies from trajectory or NPZ files
